reviewMethod: Read fixed REC sec-page-nav-applicability and sec-sync-order plus the surrounding optional-objective conformance scope. Independent inherited conditions, not unconditional implementation support.

constraints.reason: The three cases independently trigger the page-navigation recommendation: dynamic equivalent of static publication, offered alternative with reasonably predictable dual use, OR workflow retaining page breaks. ANY case suffices; all three are not jointly required and the recommendation is not MUST.
constraints.applicability: EPUB accessibility page navigation when at least one selected condition is true; retain distinctions between availability of page navigation and OPTIONAL page-break markers.
constraints.phase: T4a navigation preservation/explicit authoring; S4 accessibility/page navigation

constraints.reason: If adopting the optional synchronized-playback ordering objective, the SHOULD reflects BOTH spine document order AND element order. Different ordering is permitted but the next paragraph's MUST requires logical playback. sec-sync-conformance explicitly says these additional objectives are OPTIONAL, not prerequisites to basic accessibility conformance.
constraints.applicability: When synchronized text-audio playback is present and this optional objective is adopted; no unconditional obligation to add audio, preserve one rigid order or claim executed playback.
constraints.phase: T4a preserved media-overlay relationships; T6 split/reference order; S4 synchronized accessibility/playback
